Imagine Black Friday... forever. Every store, ninety percent off. Every single day. It never ends.
A TV for nine dollars? I'll take ten!
Week two. You can't see the floor anymore. Just boxes.
Week three. Dad sleeps in a tent outside the store. Every night. Just in case.
The deals start at five a.m.!
Week four. Your dog has forty-seven beds. He still sleeps on the floor.
Fun fact. The name Black Friday came from police in Philadelphia. They hated the crazy crowds.
Christmas. You open your present. It's a TV. You already have eleven.
Month six. The stores sold everything for almost nothing. One by one, they close.
Then Dad finds the last store on Earth. One toaster. Full price: thirty dollars.
The cashier just smiles. Don't worry. Tomorrow is Cyber Monday. Forever.
